guide.summary: English uses one word where Chinese has two or three, and the Chinese words are not interchangeable: they differ in what they take as object, in word class, or in time. Never choose by the English. Ask the question that splits the set: a fact or a person? already happened or not yet? a place or a person? does an object follow? The grammar around the blank decides.

subs.label: 知道 / 认识 / 了解: know
subs.focus: 知道 + a fact, name or clause (知道他住在哪儿); 认识 + a person, character or road (be acquainted, recognise; 很高兴认识你); 了解 = know in depth and takes 很 / 不太. Classic mistakes: 很知道, 知道 for 'we have met'. With a person object, the cue must force 'met'.

subs.label: 明白 / 懂 / 清楚: understand, clear
subs.focus: 清楚 = clear to eye or ear (看清楚, 说得很清楚, 我不清楚 = not sure); 懂 = grasp meaning, know a language or skill (听懂, 懂法语); 明白 = see the point (明白你的意思). Classic mistakes: 说得很懂, 听清楚 for 'understood'. Never cloze 懂 vs 明白 in 我___了 or 听___了.

subs.label: 又 / 再 / 还: again, still
subs.focus: 又 = a repeat that already happened (昨天又迟到了); 再 = one still to come (请再说一遍, 明天再来); 还 = still or in addition (还在下雨, 还要一杯). A time cue must decide. Do not cloze 还 vs 再 in yes/no questions or next to 想 / 要; the 又 / 再 / 还 topic drills those.

subs.label: 以后 / 后来 / 然后: afterwards
subs.focus: Clause + 以后 = after X, past or future, and 以后 alone = from now on; 后来 = later on, past story only, stands alone, never after a clause; 然后 = and then, the next step, often after 先. Classic mistakes: 后来 for the future, 下课后来, 然后 attached to a clause.

subs.label: 的时候 / 时 / 以前: when, before
subs.focus: Clause + 的时候 = when / while; clause + 时 = the same in written or formal style, with no 的; clause + 以前 = before; 以前 alone = in the past. The time clause comes first. Classic mistakes: English order (main clause first), 以前 in front of its clause, 以前 for 'when I was a student'.

subs.label: 帮 / 帮助 / 帮忙: help
subs.focus: 帮 + person + verb is everyday help (帮我拿一下); 帮助 takes a person and is also the noun (谢谢你的帮助); 帮忙 is verb + object and takes no object of its own (帮个忙, 帮我一个忙). Classic mistakes: 帮忙我, 谢谢你的帮. Do not cloze 帮 vs 帮助 before person + verb: both work.

subs.label: 以为 / 认为 / 觉得: think
subs.focus: 以为 = believed something that turned out false; the sentence must show the reversal (原来, 其实, 没想到). 觉得 = feel or find, opinions and body sensations; 认为 = considered judgement, more formal, never body feelings. Classic mistakes: 认为 with 原来, 认为很饿. Never cloze 觉得 vs 认为 on a plain opinion.

subs.label: 参观 / 访问 / 看望, 旅行 / 旅游
subs.focus: 参观 + a place you look round (博物馆, 工厂); 看望 + a person you care about; 访问 = official visit to a country or organisation, or a website. 旅行 / 旅游 take no place object: 去 + place + 旅游. Classic mistakes: 参观奶奶, 访问北京 for a holiday. Never cloze 旅行 vs 旅游.

subs.label: 合适 / 适合, 突然 / 忽然, 经验 / 经历
subs.focus: 合适 is an adjective with no object (很合适, 合适的工作); 适合 is a verb that needs one (适合你). 突然 is also an adjective (太突然了), 忽然 only an adverb. 经验 is know-how (有经验); 经历 is what you went through, noun or verb. Never cloze 突然 vs 忽然 before a verb.

subs.label: 发现 / 发明, 通过 / 经过, 关于 / 对于
subs.focus: 发现 = find or notice what exists, 发明 = invent. 经过 = go past a place; 通过 = by means of, pass an exam. 关于 = about a topic (关于熊猫的书); 对于 = towards, as for (对于我来说). Classic mistakes: 发明 for noticing, 通过 a shop, 关于我来说. Never cloze 通过 vs 经过 before 努力.

rules.rule: 知道 a fact, 认识 a person (or a character, a road), 了解 something or someone in depth.
rules.pattern: 知道 + fact / clause; 认识 + person; 很 / 不太 + 了解 + topic

examples.py: nǐ zhī dào tā zhù zài nǎ r ma
examples.en: Do you know where he lives?

examples.zh: 我认识他，我们是大学同学。
examples.py: wǒ rèn shi tā wǒ men shì dà xué tóng xué
examples.en: I know him; we were at university together.

examples.py: wǒ bù tài liǎo jiě zhōng guó lì shǐ
examples.en: I don't know much about Chinese history.

rules.note: 知道 and 认识 never take 很; 了解 does (我很了解他 = I know him well). 我知道他 means 'I know who he is' (heard of him), not that you have met.

rules.rule: 清楚 = clear to the eye or ear; 懂 = grasp the meaning, or know a language or skill; 明白 = see the point.
rules.pattern: Verb + 清楚 / 懂; Verb + 得 + 很清楚; 懂 + language; 明白 + 意思

examples.zh: 我听清楚了，可是没听懂。
examples.py: wǒ tīng qīng chu le kě shì méi tīng dǒng
examples.en: I heard it clearly, but I didn't understand it.

examples.py: lǎo shī shuō de hěn qīng chu
examples.en: The teacher explained it very clearly.

examples.py: wǒ míng bai nǐ de yì si le
examples.en: I see what you mean.

examples.py: tā dǒng fǎ yǔ
examples.en: He knows French.

rules.note: 我不清楚 means 'I'm not sure'. 我懂了 and 我明白了 both mean 'I get it', and 听懂 / 听明白 are both fine. 清楚 can also mean 'know full well' about a situation: 这件事我很清楚.

rules.rule: 又 = again, already happened; 再 = again, not yet happened; 还 = still, or something more.
rules.pattern: 又 + verb + 了; 再 + verb (request, plan); 还 + 在 / 没 / 要

examples.py: tā jīn tiān yòu chí dào le
examples.en: He was late again today.

examples.py: qǐng zài shuō yí biàn
examples.en: Please say it again.

examples.py: wài miàn hái zài xià yǔ
examples.en: It's still raining outside.

rules.note: 还 goes before 想 / 要 (我还想去), 再 after them (我想再去一次). The 又 / 再 / 还 topic covers the full set. Exception: 又 can look ahead to a repeat that is certain, usually 又是…了 (明天又是星期一了).

rules.rule: 以后 follows a clause or means 'from now on'; 后来 opens a later part of a past story; 然后 is the next step.
rules.pattern: Clause + 以后; 后来 + past event; 先 A，然后 B

examples.zh: 下课以后我们去吃饭吧。
examples.py: xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ men qù chī fàn ba
examples.en: Let's go and eat after class.

examples.zh: 我们以前是同事，后来他去了上海。
examples.py: wǒ men yǐ qián shì tóng shì hòu lái tā qù le shàng hǎi
examples.en: We used to be colleagues; later he went to Shanghai.

examples.py: nǐ xiān xǐ shǒu rán hòu chī fàn
examples.en: Wash your hands first, then eat.

examples.py: yǐ hòu wǒ měi tiān dōu huì zǎo qǐ
examples.en: From now on I'll get up early every day.

rules.note: 后来 never looks forward: for the future say 以后. 后来 cannot follow a clause: 下课以后, not 下课后来.

rules.rule: Put the time clause first: clause + 的时候 for 'when', clause + 以前 for 'before'.
rules.pattern: Clause + 的时候 / 时 / 以前，main clause

examples.py: wǒ xiǎo de shí hou zhù zài běi jīng
examples.en: When I was little I lived in Beijing.

examples.py: shuì jiào yǐ qián bié hē kā fēi
examples.en: Don't drink coffee before bed.

examples.py: shàng kè shí qǐng guān shǒu jī
examples.en: Please switch off your phone in class.

rules.note: 时 is the written form of 的时候 and attaches straight to the verb phrase: 上课时, 离开时. 以前 alone means 'in the past': 我以前不喝咖啡.

rules.rule: 帮 + person + verb for everyday help; 帮助 for helping a person or as the noun 'help'; 帮忙 never takes an object.
rules.pattern: 帮 + person + verb; 帮助 + person; 帮 + person + 的忙 / 帮个忙

examples.py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ ná yí xià ma
examples.en: Could you hold this for me for a moment?

examples.py: xiè xie nǐ de bāng zhù
examples.en: Thank you for your help.

examples.py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ yí gè máng ma
examples.en: Could you do me a favour?

examples.py: tā bāng le wǒ hěn dà de máng
examples.en: He was a great help to me.

rules.note: 帮忙 splits around what is added: 帮我的忙, 帮了一个忙. With no object it stands whole: 他常常来帮忙.

rules.rule: 以为 = I thought, but I was wrong; 觉得 = I feel or find; 认为 = I consider, after thinking it through.
rules.pattern: 以为 + belief，原来 / 其实 + truth; 觉得 + feeling; 认为 + judgement

examples.zh: 我以为你走了，原来你还在这儿。
examples.py: wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ zǒu le yuán lái nǐ hái zài zhè r
examples.en: I thought you'd left, but you're still here.

examples.py: wǒ jué de jīn tiān hěn lěng
examples.en: I find it cold today.

examples.zh: 专家认为这个办法不行。
examples.py: zhuān jiā rèn wéi zhè ge bàn fǎ bù xíng
examples.en: Experts think this method won't work.

rules.note: With 觉得 or 认为 the belief may be true; 以为 tells the listener it was not. 认为 is never used for body feelings: 我觉得饿, not 我认为饿.

rules.rule: 参观 a place you look round, 看望 a person you care about, 访问 for an official visit; 旅游 / 旅行 take no place object.
rules.pattern: 参观 + place; 去 + 看望 + person; 去 + place + 旅游 / 旅行

examples.zh: 我们下午去参观博物馆。
examples.py: wǒ men xià wǔ qù cān guān bó wù guǎn
examples.en: We're visiting the museum this afternoon.

examples.zh: 周末我去医院看望奶奶。
examples.py: zhōu mò wǒ qù yī yuàn kàn wàng nǎi nai
examples.en: At the weekend I'm going to the hospital to see grandma.

examples.py: wǒ men shǔ jià qù yún nán lǚ yóu
examples.en: We're going to Yunnan on holiday this summer.

rules.note: 访问 is official (a head of state, a school delegation) or a website (访问网站). 旅游 leans to sightseeing (旅游景点), 旅行 to the journey (旅行箱); in 去 + place + ___ both are fine.

rules.rule: 合适 is an adjective and takes no object; 适合 is a verb and needs one.
rules.pattern: 很合适 / 合适的 + noun; 适合 + person or thing

examples.py: zhè jiàn yī fu dà xiǎo hěn hé shì
examples.en: This top is just the right size.

examples.py: zhè ge gōng zuò hěn shì hé nǐ
examples.en: This job really suits you.

examples.zh: 我还没找到合适的房子。
examples.py: wǒ hái méi zhǎo dào hé shì de fáng zi
examples.en: I haven't found a suitable flat yet.

rules.note: Say 适合你 or 对你很合适, never 合适你.

rules.rule: 突然 and 经历 do two jobs, 忽然 and 经验 one: 突然 is also an adjective, 忽然 only an adverb; 经历 is also a verb, 经验 only a noun.
rules.pattern: 太突然了; 忽然 + verb; 经历了 + events; 有 / 没有 + 经验

examples.py: zhè ge xiāo xi tài tū rán le
examples.en: This news is so sudden.

examples.py: tiān hū rán hēi le
examples.en: The sky suddenly went dark.

examples.py: tā jīng lì le hěn duō kùn nan
examples.en: He has been through a lot of hardship.

examples.py: tā hěn yǒu jīng yàn
examples.en: She is very experienced.

rules.note: Before a verb 突然 and 忽然 are both fine (他突然哭了 / 他忽然哭了). 经验 is what you learned; 经历 is what happened to you (一次难忘的经历).

rules.rule: 发现 = find or notice what is already there; 发明 = create something new. 经过 = go past a place; 通过 = by means of, or pass a test.
rules.pattern: 发现 + fact; 发明 + new thing; 经过 + place; 通过 + means / 考试

examples.py: wǒ fā xiàn qián bāo bú jiàn le
examples.en: I found my wallet was missing.

examples.py: zhǐ shì zhōng guó rén fā míng de
examples.en: Paper was invented by the Chinese.

examples.zh: 我每天上班都经过这家银行。
examples.py: wǒ měi tiān shàng bān dōu jīng guò zhè jiā yín háng
examples.en: I pass this bank every day on my way to work.

examples.py: tā tōng guò le zhè cì kǎo shì
examples.en: She passed this exam.

rules.note: 经过 also means 'after going through' (经过三年的努力), where 通过 is also heard: do not contrast them there. 通过 can also mean 'pass through' (火车通过大桥): use 经过 for going past a shop or a person's door.

rules.rule: 关于 introduces a topic (about); 对于 introduces what an attitude or effect is aimed at (towards, as for).
rules.pattern: 关于 + topic + 的 + noun; 对于 + person + 来说

examples.zh: 这是一本关于熊猫的书。
examples.py: zhè shì yì běn guān yú xióng māo de shū
examples.en: This is a book about pandas.

examples.py: duì yú wǒ lái shuō hàn zì zuì nán
examples.en: For me, characters are the hardest part.

examples.zh: 关于这件事，我们明天再谈。
examples.py: guān yú zhè jiàn shì wǒ men míng tiān zài tán
examples.en: Let's talk about this tomorrow.

rules.note: A 关于 phrase normally opens the sentence or comes before 的 + noun. 对于 can also follow the subject, and everyday speech often shortens it to 对.

right.py: wǒ hěn liǎo jiě zhōng guó wén huà

contrasts.why: 知道 never takes 很. Knowing something in depth is 了解.

right.py: tā shuō de hěn qīng chu

contrasts.why: How clearly someone speaks is 清楚. 懂 is what the listener does; it never describes the speaking.

right.py: xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ men qù dǎ qiú
right.en: After class we're going to play ball.

contrasts.why: 后来 stands alone and only looks back on a past story; it never attaches to a clause. 'After class' is 下课以后.
帮忙 already contains its object 忙 and cannot take another. Use 帮 + person + verb, or 帮你的忙.

contrasts.wrong: 我认为你已经回家了，原来你还在这儿。

right.zh: 我以为你已经回家了，原来你还在这儿。
right.py: wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ yǐ jīng huí jiā le yuán lái nǐ hái zài zhè r
right.en: I thought you'd gone home, but you're still here.

contrasts.why: 原来 shows the belief was false, so it must be 以为. 认为 states a judgement you still hold.

right.py: zhōu mò wǒ qù kàn wàng nǎi nai
right.en: At the weekend I'm going to see grandma.

contrasts.why: 参观 is for places you look round. A person you go to see is 看望, or simply 看.

right.py: zhè jiàn yī fu hěn shì hé wǒ

contrasts.why: 合适 is an adjective and cannot take an object. With an object, use the verb 适合.

right.py: wǒ jīng lì le hěn duō kùn nan
right.en: I've been through a lot of hardship.

contrasts.why: 经验 is only a noun (know-how). The verb 'go through' is 经历.

contrasts.wrong: 我发明我的手机不见了。

right.zh: 我发现我的手机不见了。
right.py: wǒ fā xiàn wǒ de shǒu jī bú jiàn le
right.en: I found my phone was missing.

contrasts.why: Noticing something that is already true is 发现. 发明 is inventing a new thing, like paper or the telephone.

contrasts.wrong: 关于我来说，这个问题很难。

right.zh: 对于我来说，这个问题很难。
right.py: duì yú wǒ lái shuō zhè ge wèn tí hěn nán
right.en: For me, this question is hard.

contrasts.why: 'As for me' is 对于…来说. 关于 only names a topic (about) and never pairs with 来说.

cheat: A fact: 知道. A person you've met: 认识. Know it well, with 很: 了解.
Already happened again: 又. Not yet: 再. Still or more: 还.
After a clause: 以后. Later in a past story: 后来. Next step: 然后.
帮忙 takes no object: 帮我, 帮我的忙, never 帮忙我.
Turned out wrong: 以为. A feeling: 觉得. A judgement: 认为.
A place: 参观. A person: 看望. Object follows: 适合, not 合适.
Before 来说: 对于. Before 的 + noun, a topic: 关于.

items.q: 我们下午去___博物馆。
items.zh: 我们下午去参观博物馆。
items.py: wǒ men xià wǔ qù cān guān bó wù guǎn
items.en: We're visiting the museum this afternoon.
items.why: Looking round a place such as a museum is 参观. 看望 is for people, and 访问 is an official visit.

items.q: 这双鞋很___我，不大也不小。
items.zh: 这双鞋很适合我，不大也不小。
items.py: zhè shuāng xié hěn shì hé wǒ bú dà yě bù xiǎo
items.en: These shoes suit me; they're neither too big nor too small.
items.why: An object (我) follows, so the verb 适合. 合适 is an adjective and cannot take an object.

items.q: 这次汉语考试很难，可是我___了。
items.zh: 这次汉语考试很难，可是我通过了。
items.py: zhè cì hàn yǔ kǎo shì hěn nán kě shì wǒ tōng guò le
items.en: This Chinese exam was hard, but I passed.
items.why: Passing a test is 通过. 经过 would mean going through or past something and does not say you succeeded.

items.q: 这本书的语言太难了，我看了三遍还是看不___。
items.zh: 这本书的语言太难了，我看了三遍还是看不懂。
items.py: zhè běn shū de yǔ yán tài nán le wǒ kàn le sān biàn hái shi kàn bù dǒng
items.en: The language in this book is so hard that I've read it three times and still can't understand it.
items.why: Not grasping a hard text is 看不懂. 看不清楚 would mean the print is too small or blurry, which is not what 太难了 describes.

items.s: 我回家的时候通过一家书店，买了一本书。
items.s_py: wǒ huí jiā de shí hou tōng guò yì jiā shū diàn mǎi le yì běn shū
items.zh: 我回家的时候经过一家书店，买了一本书。
items.py: wǒ huí jiā de shí hou jīng guò yì jiā shū diàn mǎi le yì běn shū
items.en: On my way home I passed a bookshop and bought a book.
items.why: Going past a shop is 经过. 通过 means 'by means of' or 'pass a test'.

items.q: 这家餐厅的价格很___，我们就在这儿吃吧。
items.zh: 这家餐厅的价格很合适，我们就在这儿吃吧。
items.py: zhè jiā cān tīng de jià gé hěn hé shì wǒ men jiù zài zhè r chī ba
items.en: The prices at this restaurant are reasonable; let's eat here.
items.why: No object follows, and 很 sits before it as an adjective: 很合适. 适合 is a verb and needs an object.

items.q: 这套房子大小正___，离地铁站也不远。
items.zh: 这套房子大小正合适，离地铁站也不远。
items.py: zhè tào fáng zi dà xiǎo zhèng hé shì lí dì tiě zhàn yě bù yuǎn
items.en: This flat is just the right size, and it's not far from the subway station either.
items.why: Nothing follows the blank, so the adjective 合适: 大小正合适 'just the right size'. 适合 is a verb and needs an object (正适合我们), so 大小正适合 is left hanging.

items.s: 关于他来说，这个工作太累了。
items.s_py: guān yú tā lái shuō zhè ge gōng zuò tài lèi le
items.zh: 对于他来说，这个工作太累了。
items.py: duì yú tā lái shuō zhè ge gōng zuò tài lèi le
items.en: For him, this job is too tiring.
items.why: 'For him' is 对于他来说. 关于 only names a topic and never pairs with 来说.

items.q: 这个消息太___了，我一点准备也没有。
items.zh: 这个消息太突然了，我一点准备也没有。
items.py: zhè ge xiāo xi tài tū rán le wǒ yì diǎn zhǔn bèi yě méi yǒu
items.en: This news is so sudden; I had no preparation at all.
items.why: 太突然了 uses 突然 as an adjective. 忽然 is only an adverb before a verb, so 太忽然了 is wrong.

items.s: 我们打算去云南旅行。
items.s_py: wǒ men dǎ suàn qù yún nán lǚ xíng
items.zh: 我们打算去云南旅行。
items.py: wǒ men dǎ suàn qù yún nán lǚ xíng
items.en: We plan to travel to Yunnan.
items.why: 去 + place + 旅行 is correct: 旅行 takes no place object of its own but follows 去 + place.

items.q: 他___了很多困难，才成了一名医生。
items.zh: 他经历了很多困难，才成了一名医生。
items.py: tā jīng lì le hěn duō kùn nan cái chéng le yì míng yī shēng
items.en: He went through many difficulties before he became a doctor.
items.why: 'Go through' is the verb 经历, followed by 了 and an object. 经验 is only a noun and cannot take 了.

items.q: 他做了一个很___的决定，大家都很吃惊。
items.zh: 他做了一个很突然的决定，大家都很吃惊。
items.py: tā zuò le yí gè hěn tū rán de jué dìng dà jiā dōu hěn chī jīng
items.en: He made a very sudden decision, and everyone was surprised.
items.why: Before 的 + noun only the adjective 突然 works. 忽然 cannot modify a noun.

items.q: 你先去挂号，___再去二楼检查。
items.zh: 你先去挂号，然后再去二楼检查。
items.py: nǐ xiān qù guà hào rán hòu zài qù èr lóu jiǎn chá
items.en: First go and register, then go to the second floor for the examination.
items.why: 先 … 然后 marks the next step in a sequence of instructions. 后来 only tells a past story and cannot be used in a command.

items.s: 昨天晚上我又没睡好。
items.s_py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ yòu méi shuì hǎo
items.zh: 昨天晚上我又没睡好。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ yòu méi shuì hǎo
items.en: I didn't sleep well again last night.
items.why: It already happened (昨天晚上), so 又 is right even with 没. 再 would be for the future.

items.q: 他的声音太小了，我没听___。
items.zh: 他的声音太小了，我没听清楚。
items.py: tā de shēng yīn tài xiǎo le wǒ méi tīng qīng chu
items.en: His voice was too quiet; I couldn't hear him clearly.
items.why: Whether a sound is clear to the ear is 清楚. 懂 and 明白 are about grasping the meaning, which is not the problem when the voice is too quiet to hear.

items.q: 你___电影院在哪儿吗？
items.zh: 你知道电影院在哪儿吗？
items.py: nǐ zhī dào diàn yǐng yuàn zài nǎ r ma
items.en: Do you know where the cinema is?
items.why: 知道 takes a fact or a clause such as 电影院在哪儿. 认识 is for people, characters and roads, and 了解 means knowing something in depth; neither takes a where-clause.

items.q: 我们暑假去云南___，那里的天气很好。
items.zh: 我们暑假去云南旅游，那里的天气很好。
items.py: wǒ men shǔ jià qù yún nán lǚ yóu nà lǐ de tiān qì hěn hǎo
items.en: We're going to Yunnan on holiday this summer; the weather there is lovely.
items.why: A holiday trip is 去 + place + 旅游. 参观 needs a place to look round as its object, and 看望 needs a person.

items.q: 十年前我们是邻居，___他搬走了，我们就没再见过面。
items.zh: 十年前我们是邻居，后来他搬走了，我们就没再见过面。
items.py: shí nián qián wǒ men shì lín jū hòu lái tā bān zǒu le wǒ men jiù méi zài jiàn guo miàn
items.en: Ten years ago we were neighbours; later he moved away and we haven't met since.
items.why: 后来 opens the next stage of a past story. A bare 以后 at the start of a clause would mean 'from now on', which does not fit a story about ten years ago.

items.q: 你能___我一个忙吗？
items.zh: 你能帮我一个忙吗？
items.py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ yí gè máng ma
items.en: Could you do me a favour?
items.why: 帮 + person + (一个)忙 is the split form of 帮忙. 帮忙 already contains 忙, so 帮忙我一个忙 repeats it, and 帮助我一个忙 is not said.

items.q: ___我来说，这首歌的意思很难懂。
items.zh: 对于我来说，这首歌的意思很难懂。
items.py: duì yú wǒ lái shuō zhè shǒu gē de yì si hěn nán dǒng
items.en: For me, the meaning of this song is hard to understand.
items.why: 'For me' is 对于我来说. 关于 only names a topic and never goes with 来说.

items.s: 他帮了我一个大忙。
items.s_py: tā bāng le wǒ yí gè dà máng
items.zh: 他帮了我一个大忙。
items.py: tā bāng le wǒ yí gè dà máng
items.en: He did me a big favour.
items.why: 帮忙 splits around the person and the measure word: 帮 + 了 + 我 + 一个大 + 忙. This is the correct way to give it an object.

items.s: 我认为很饿，我们去吃饭吧。
items.s_py: wǒ rèn wéi hěn è wǒ men qù chī fàn ba
items.zh: 我觉得很饿，我们去吃饭吧。
items.py: wǒ jué de hěn è wǒ men qù chī fàn ba
items.en: I feel very hungry; let's go and eat.
items.why: Hunger is a body feeling, so 觉得. 认为 is never used for body feelings.

items.q: 我们先坐地铁，___换公交车去机场。
items.zh: 我们先坐地铁，然后换公交车去机场。
items.py: wǒ men xiān zuò dì tiě rán hòu huàn gōng jiāo chē qù jī chǎng
items.en: We'll take the subway first, then change to a bus to the airport.
items.why: 先 … 然后 gives the next step of a plan. 后来 only looks back at a past story and cannot carry a plan or instruction.

items.q: 这个汉字我不___，你能念一下吗？
items.zh: 这个汉字我不认识，你能念一下吗？
items.py: zhè ge hàn zì wǒ bú rèn shi nǐ néng niàn yí xià ma
items.en: I don't recognise this character; can you read it out?
items.why: 认识 is the verb for recognising a character, a person or a road. 了解 is for knowing a topic or a person in depth and does not fit one character you cannot read.

items.q: 请___我拿一下这个箱子，好吗？
items.zh: 请帮我拿一下这个箱子，好吗？
items.py: qǐng bāng wǒ ná yí xià zhè ge xiāng zi hǎo ma
items.en: Please help me carry this suitcase for a moment, will you?
items.why: Everyday help with a task is 帮 + person + verb. 帮忙 takes no object, so 帮忙我拿 is wrong.

items.q: 我买了一本___北京地铁的书，里面有很多老照片。
items.zh: 我买了一本关于北京地铁的书，里面有很多老照片。
items.py: wǒ mǎi le yì běn guān yú běi jīng dì tiě de shū lǐ miàn yǒu hěn duō lǎo zhào piàn
items.en: I bought a book about the Beijing subway, with many old photos in it.
items.why: 'A book about a topic' is 关于 + topic + 的 + noun. 对于 means 'towards' or 'as for' and does not introduce the subject of a book.

items.s: 周末我想去参观我的朋友。
items.s_py: zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng qù cān guān wǒ de péng you
items.zh: 周末我想去看望我的朋友。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng qù kàn wàng wǒ de péng you
items.en: At the weekend I want to go and see my friend.
items.why: 参观 is for places you look round. Visiting a person is 看望, or simply 看.

items.q: 下个月市长要___日本，跟几家大公司的老板见面。
items.zh: 下个月市长要访问日本，跟几家大公司的老板见面。
items.py: xià ge yuè shì zhǎng yào fǎng wèn rì běn gēn jǐ jiā dà gōng sī de lǎo bǎn jiàn miàn
items.en: Next month the mayor will visit Japan and meet the heads of several big companies.
items.why: An official visit to a country is 访问. 参观日本 would mean looking round Japan like a sight, 旅游 takes no object, and 看望 is for people.

items.s: 这条路经过一座小桥，然后就到公园了。
items.s_py: zhè tiáo lù jīng guò yí zuò xiǎo qiáo rán hòu jiù dào gōng yuán le
items.zh: 这条路经过一座小桥，然后就到公园了。
items.py: zhè tiáo lù jīng guò yí zuò xiǎo qiáo rán hòu jiù dào gōng yuán le
items.en: This road goes past a small bridge, and then you're at the park.
items.why: 经过 is right for passing a place on the way, and 然后 links the next step.

items.q: 他在这个小区住了很多年，对邻居们都很___。
items.zh: 他在这个小区住了很多年，对邻居们都很了解。
items.py: tā zài zhè ge xiǎo qū zhù le hěn duō nián duì lín jū men dōu hěn liǎo jiě
items.en: He has lived in this neighbourhood for many years and knows all the neighbours well.
items.why: Knowing people well after years of living beside them is 了解, and only 了解 can follow 很. 很认识 and 很知道 are not Chinese.

items.q: 搬家那天，邻居们都来___了。
items.zh: 搬家那天，邻居们都来帮忙了。
items.py: bān jiā nà tiān lín jū men dōu lái bāng máng le
items.en: On the day we moved, all the neighbours came to help.
items.why: No person is mentioned, so the whole verb-object 帮忙 stands alone. 帮助 and 帮 both need someone to help.

items.q: 我在这座城市住了三十年，所以很___它的历史。
items.zh: 我在这座城市住了三十年，所以很了解它的历史。
items.py: wǒ zài zhè zuò chéng shì zhù le sān shí nián suǒ yǐ hěn liǎo jiě tā de lì shǐ
items.en: I've lived in this city for thirty years, so I know its history very well.
items.why: Knowing something in depth, and with 很, is 了解. 知道 and 认识 never take 很, so 很知道 and 很认识 are both wrong.

items.q: 在北京学习的这段___，我一辈子也不会忘。
items.zh: 在北京学习的这段经历，我一辈子也不会忘。
items.py: zài běi jīng xué xí de zhè duàn jīng lì wǒ yí bèi zi yě bú huì wàng
items.en: I will never forget my time studying in Beijing, as long as I live.
items.why: A period of life you went through and remember is 经历. 经验 is skill learned from practice, not a memory.

items.q: 看电影___，请把手机关掉。
items.zh: 看电影的时候，请把手机关掉。
items.py: kàn diàn yǐng de shí hou qǐng bǎ shǒu jī guān diào
items.en: Please turn your phone off while you're watching the film.
items.why: 'While watching' is the clause plus 的时候. 以前 would mean before the film and 以后 after it.

items.q: 这首歌很___晚上听，听着听着就想睡觉了。
items.zh: 这首歌很适合晚上听，听着听着就想睡觉了。
items.py: zhè shǒu gē hěn shì hé wǎn shang tīng tīng zhe tīng zhe jiù xiǎng shuì jiào le
items.en: This song is well suited to listening at night; you start to feel sleepy as you listen.
items.why: The verb 适合 takes the phrase 晚上听 as its object. The adjective 合适 cannot take an object after it.

items.q: 这个手机软件对学汉语的人很有___。
items.zh: 这个手机软件对学汉语的人很有帮助。
items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī ruǎn jiàn duì xué hàn yǔ de rén hěn yǒu bāng zhù
items.en: This phone app is very helpful for people who study Chinese.
items.why: 'Be helpful' is 有帮助, using 帮助 as a noun. 有帮忙 and 有帮 do not exist.

items.q: 他___我是医生，其实我是老师。
items.zh: 他以为我是医生，其实我是老师。
items.py: tā yǐ wéi wǒ shì yī shēng qí shí wǒ shì lǎo shī
items.en: He thought I was a doctor, but actually I'm a teacher.
items.why: 其实 reveals that his belief was false, so 以为. 觉得 would state an opinion that the rest of the sentence contradicts.

items.s: 天忽然下起了大雨，我们只好在地铁站里等了一会儿。
items.s_py: tiān hū rán xià qǐ le dà yǔ wǒ men zhǐ hǎo zài dì tiě zhàn lǐ děng le yí huì r
items.zh: 天忽然下起了大雨，我们只好在地铁站里等了一会儿。
items.py: tiān hū rán xià qǐ le dà yǔ wǒ men zhǐ hǎo zài dì tiě zhàn lǐ děng le yí huì r
items.en: It suddenly started pouring, so we had to wait in the subway station for a while.
items.why: 忽然 is a perfectly good adverb before a verb phrase like 下起了大雨. Only after 太 or before 的 would it fail.

items.q: 吃了药以后，我___头不疼了。
items.zh: 吃了药以后，我觉得头不疼了。
items.py: chī le yào yǐ hòu wǒ jué de tóu bù téng le
items.en: After taking the medicine, I feel my headache has gone.
items.why: A bodily sensation is 觉得. 认为 is never used for body feelings, and 以为 would suggest the feeling turned out false.

items.q: 电话是谁___的？
items.zh: 电话是谁发明的？
items.py: diàn huà shì shéi fā míng de
items.en: Who invented the telephone?
items.why: Creating a new thing such as the telephone is 发明. 发现 is for finding or noticing what already exists.

items.s: 谢谢你的帮，我找到房子了。
items.s_py: xiè xie nǐ de bāng wǒ zhǎo dào fáng zi le
items.zh: 谢谢你的帮助，我找到房子了。
items.py: xiè xie nǐ de bāng zhù wǒ zhǎo dào fáng zi le
items.en: Thanks for your help; I've found a flat.
items.why: After 你的 the noun 'help' is 帮助. 帮 is a verb only.

items.s: 你认识他住在哪儿吗？
items.s_py: nǐ rèn shi tā zhù zài nǎ r ma
items.zh: 你知道他住在哪儿吗？
items.py: nǐ zhī dào tā zhù zài nǎ r ma
items.en: Do you know where he lives?
items.why: A where-clause is a fact, so 知道. 认识 takes a person, character or road, not a clause.

items.q: 我___太累了，想早点回家休息。
items.zh: 我觉得太累了，想早点回家休息。
items.py: wǒ jué de tài lèi le xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí jiā xiū xi
items.en: I feel really tired and want to go home early to rest.
items.why: Feeling tired is 觉得. 认为太累了 is wrong because 认为 is a considered judgement, not a body feeling.

items.s: 下课后来我们去喝咖啡吧。
items.s_py: xià kè hòu lái wǒ men qù hē kā fēi ba
items.zh: 下课以后我们去喝咖啡吧。
items.py: xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ men qù hē kā fēi ba
items.en: Let's go for a coffee after class.
items.why: 'After class' is clause + 以后. 后来 stands alone and only looks back at a past story.

items.q: 我___音乐会在今天，原来是明天。
items.zh: 我以为音乐会在今天，原来是明天。
items.py: wǒ yǐ wéi yīn yuè huì zài jīn tiān yuán lái shì míng tiān
items.en: I thought the concert was today, but it turns out it's tomorrow.
items.why: 原来 shows the belief was wrong, which is exactly what 以为 signals. 认为 and 觉得 state a view that you still hold.

items.q: 谢谢你的___，我现在好多了。
items.zh: 谢谢你的帮助，我现在好多了。
items.py: xiè xie nǐ de bāng zhù wǒ xiàn zài hǎo duō le
items.en: Thank you for your help; I'm much better now.
items.why: After 的 the noun 'help' is 帮助. 帮 is only a verb and cannot be used as a noun, so 你的帮 is wrong.

items.q: 我___在北京住，现在住在上海。
items.zh: 我以前在北京住，现在住在上海。
items.py: wǒ yǐ qián zài běi jīng zhù xiàn zài zhù zài shàng hǎi
items.en: I used to live in Beijing; now I live in Shanghai.
items.why: 以前 on its own means 'in the past', which sets up the contrast with 现在. 以后 looks forward, and 后来 needs an earlier stage of a story before it.

items.q: 这部电影太好看了，下个月我们___去看一次吧。
items.zh: 这部电影太好看了，下个月我们再去看一次吧。
items.py: zhè bù diàn yǐng tài hǎo kàn le xià ge yuè wǒ men zài qù kàn yí cì ba
items.en: This film is so good; let's go and see it again next month.
items.why: A repeat planned for next month has not happened, so 再. 又 is for a repeat that has already taken place.

items.q: 老师说得很___，大家都听懂了。
items.zh: 老师说得很清楚，大家都听懂了。
items.py: lǎo shī shuō de hěn qīng chu dà jiā dōu tīng dǒng le
items.en: The teacher explained it very clearly, and everyone understood.
items.why: How clearly someone speaks is 清楚 after 得. 懂 is what the listener does, so 说得很懂 is wrong.

items.q: 我今天早上___钱包不见了，马上去了警察局。
items.zh: 我今天早上发现钱包不见了，马上去了警察局。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān zǎo shang fā xiàn qián bāo bú jiàn le mǎ shàng qù le jǐng chá jú
items.en: I found my wallet was missing this morning and went straight to the police station.
items.why: Noticing that something is already the case is 发现. 发明 means to invent something new.

items.q: 医生___，感冒的时候应该多喝水、多休息。
items.zh: 医生认为，感冒的时候应该多喝水、多休息。
items.py: yī shēng rèn wéi gǎn mào de shí hou yīng gāi duō hē shuǐ duō xiū xi
items.en: The doctor holds that when you have a cold you should drink lots of water and rest.
items.why: A professional judgement the speaker accepts is 认为. 以为 would say the doctor was mistaken, which nothing in the sentence suggests.

items.s: 关于这家电影院，我听过很多有意思的故事。
items.s_py: guān yú zhè jiā diàn yǐng yuàn wǒ tīng guo hěn duō yǒu yì si de gù shi
items.zh: 关于这家电影院，我听过很多有意思的故事。
items.py: guān yú zhè jiā diàn yǐng yuàn wǒ tīng guo hěn duō yǒu yì si de gù shi
items.en: I've heard lots of interesting stories about this cinema.
items.why: A 关于 phrase naming the topic can open the sentence: 'about this cinema'. This is the normal use of 关于.

items.q: 我走路去地铁站___，下起了雨。
items.zh: 我走路去地铁站的时候，下起了雨。
items.py: wǒ zǒu lù qù dì tiě zhàn de shí hou xià qǐ le yǔ
items.en: It started to rain while I was walking to the subway station.
items.why: Rain starting during the walk is clause + 的时候. 以前 and 以后 would put the rain before or after the walk.

items.q: 太晚了，别看电影了，明天___看吧。
items.zh: 太晚了，别看电影了，明天再看吧。
items.py: tài wǎn le bié kàn diàn yǐng le míng tiān zài kàn ba
items.en: It's too late; stop watching the film and watch it tomorrow.
items.why: Resuming tomorrow is a repeat still to come, so 再. 又 would need it to have happened already.

items.s: 这份工作对你很合适，你就接受吧。
items.s_py: zhè fèn gōng zuò duì nǐ hěn hé shì nǐ jiù jiē shòu ba
items.zh: 这份工作对你很合适，你就接受吧。
items.py: zhè fèn gōng zuò duì nǐ hěn hé shì nǐ jiù jiē shòu ba
items.en: This job is a good fit for you; just accept it.
items.why: 对你很合适 is correct: the person is introduced by 对, so 合适 needs no object of its own. 这份工作很适合你 would also work.

items.q: 老师___我们学好汉语，我们都很感谢她。
items.zh: 老师帮助我们学好汉语，我们都很感谢她。
items.py: lǎo shī bāng zhù wǒ men xué hǎo hàn yǔ wǒ men dōu hěn gǎn xiè tā
items.en: The teacher helps us learn Chinese well, and we are all grateful to her.
items.why: A person (我们) plus a verb phrase follows, so the verb is 帮助. 帮忙 takes no object, so 帮忙我们 is wrong.

items.q: 来北京的外国朋友都想___故宫。
items.zh: 来北京的外国朋友都想参观故宫。
items.py: lái běi jīng de wài guó péng you dōu xiǎng cān guān gù gōng
items.en: All the foreign friends who come to Beijing want to visit the Forbidden City.
items.why: A sight you look round takes 参观 as a direct verb. 旅游 never takes a place as its object, so 旅游故宫 is wrong.

items.s: 他通过努力，终于考上了大学。
items.s_py: tā tōng guò nǔ lì zhōng yú kǎo shàng le dà xué
items.zh: 他通过努力，终于考上了大学。
items.py: tā tōng guò nǔ lì zhōng yú kǎo shàng le dà xué
items.en: Through hard work, he finally got into university.
items.why: 通过 + means is correct: 'by means of effort'.

items.s: 我以为是周末，原来今天要上班。
items.s_py: wǒ yǐ wéi shì zhōu mò yuán lái jīn tiān yào shàng bān
items.zh: 我以为是周末，原来今天要上班。
items.py: wǒ yǐ wéi shì zhōu mò yuán lái jīn tiān yào shàng bān
items.en: I thought it was the weekend, but it turns out I have to work today.
items.why: 以为 is right because 原来 shows the belief was mistaken.

items.s: 我知道他，可是我们没见过面。
items.s_py: wǒ zhī dào tā kě shì wǒ men méi jiàn guo miàn
items.zh: 我知道他，可是我们没见过面。
items.py: wǒ zhī dào tā kě shì wǒ men méi jiàn guo miàn
items.en: I know who he is, but we've never met.
items.why: 知道 + person means knowing of him, not having met him, so it fits 没见过面. 认识 would be the choice if they had met.

items.q: 看了两个小时电影，我___眼睛很不舒服。
items.zh: 看了两个小时电影，我觉得眼睛很不舒服。
items.py: kàn le liǎng gè xiǎo shí diàn yǐng wǒ jué de yǎn jing hěn bù shū fu
items.en: After watching films for two hours, my eyes feel very uncomfortable.
items.why: Physical discomfort is 觉得. 认为 is for considered judgements and cannot report how your eyes feel.

items.s: 这个房子很合适我。
items.s_py: zhè ge fáng zi hěn hé shì wǒ
items.zh: 这个房子很适合我。
items.py: zhè ge fáng zi hěn shì hé wǒ
items.en: This flat suits me well.
items.why: 合适 is an adjective and cannot take an object. With 我 after it, use the verb 适合.

items.q: 我感冒一个星期了，今天___在发烧。
items.zh: 我感冒一个星期了，今天还在发烧。
items.py: wǒ gǎn mào yí gè xīng qī le jīn tiān hái zài fā shāo
items.en: I've had this cold for a week, and today I still have a fever.
items.why: The fever is a continuing state, so 还在 for 'still'. 又 is for a repeat and 再 for a future repeat; neither means 'still going on'.

items.q: 我听音乐___，不喜欢别人跟我说话。
items.zh: 我听音乐的时候，不喜欢别人跟我说话。
items.py: wǒ tīng yīn yuè de shí hou bù xǐ huan bié rén gēn wǒ shuō huà
items.en: When I'm listening to music, I don't like people talking to me.
items.why: Not liking interruptions while listening is 的时候. 听音乐以前 would be before listening, when there is no music to be interrupted.

items.q: 我不___明天的电影几点开始。
items.zh: 我不知道明天的电影几点开始。
items.py: wǒ bù zhī dào míng tiān de diàn yǐng jǐ diǎn kāi shǐ
items.en: I don't know what time tomorrow's film starts.
items.why: A fact, here a start time inside a question clause, is 知道. 了解 and 认识 cannot introduce a 几点 clause.

items.q: 我每天上班都___那家书店，有时候进去看看。
items.zh: 我每天上班都经过那家书店，有时候进去看看。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān shàng bān dōu jīng guò nà jiā shū diàn yǒu shí hou jìn qù kàn kan
items.en: I pass that bookshop on my way to work every day and sometimes go in.
items.why: Going past a place on the way is 经过. 通过 means 'by means of' or 'pass a test' and is not used for walking past a shop.

items.q: 昨天我___迟到了，老板很生气。
items.zh: 昨天我又迟到了，老板很生气。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ yòu chí dào le lǎo bǎn hěn shēng qì
items.en: I was late again yesterday, and my boss was very angry.
items.why: Late again, and it already happened (昨天), so 又 with 了. 再 is for a repeat still to come.

items.q: 我想先___一下这家医院，再决定去不去。
items.zh: 我想先了解一下这家医院，再决定去不去。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng xiān liǎo jiě yí xià zhè jiā yī yuàn zài jué dìng qù bú qù
items.en: I want to find out about this hospital first, then decide whether to go.
items.why: Looking into something to learn it properly is 了解一下. 知道一下 and 认识一下 do not mean that; 认识一下 would be for meeting a person.

items.q: 过年的时候，我们回老家___爷爷奶奶。
items.zh: 过年的时候，我们回老家看望爷爷奶奶。
items.py: guò nián de shí hou wǒ men huí lǎo jiā kàn wàng yé ye nǎi nai
items.en: At New Year we go back to our home town to see my grandparents.
items.why: Visiting elderly relatives you care about is 看望. 参观 is for places and 访问 for official visits.

items.q: 请把电话号码写___，不然我认不出来。
items.zh: 请把电话号码写清楚，不然我认不出来。
items.py: qǐng bǎ diàn huà hào mǎ xiě qīng chu bù rán wǒ rèn bù chū lái
items.en: Please write the phone number clearly, or I won't be able to make it out.
items.why: Writing something so that it is easy to read is 写清楚. 写懂 and 写明白 do not describe handwriting.

items.s: 我认为你在家，原来你出去了。
items.s_py: wǒ rèn wéi nǐ zài jiā yuán lái nǐ chū qù le
items.zh: 我以为你在家，原来你出去了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ zài jiā yuán lái nǐ chū qù le
items.en: I thought you were at home, but it turns out you'd gone out.
items.why: 原来 shows the belief was wrong, so 以为. 认为 states a judgement you still hold.

items.s: 他想帮忙我找房子。
items.s_py: tā xiǎng bāng máng wǒ zhǎo fáng zi
items.zh: 他想帮我找房子。
items.py: tā xiǎng bāng wǒ zhǎo fáng zi
items.en: He wants to help me find a flat.
items.why: 帮忙 already contains its own object 忙 and cannot take 我. Use 帮 + person + verb.

items.q: 他先在医院工作了两年，___去了大学教书。
items.zh: 他先在医院工作了两年，然后去了大学教书。
items.py: tā xiān zài yī yuàn gōng zuò le liǎng nián rán hòu qù le dà xué jiāo shū
items.en: He first worked in a hospital for two years, then went to teach at a university.
items.why: 先 sets up a sequence, and the next step is introduced by 然后. 以后 at the head of a clause looks ahead ('from now on') and does not answer 先.

items.s: 我很知道他的想法。
items.s_py: wǒ hěn zhī dào tā de xiǎng fa
items.zh: 我很了解他的想法。
items.py: wǒ hěn liǎo jiě tā de xiǎng fa
items.en: I understand his way of thinking very well.
items.why: 知道 never takes 很. Knowing someone's thinking well is 了解.

items.q: 吃完饭___，我们去公园走走吧。
items.zh: 吃完饭以后，我们去公园走走吧。
items.py: chī wán fàn yǐ hòu wǒ men qù gōng yuán zǒu zou ba
items.en: After dinner, let's go for a walk in the park.
items.why: After a clause (吃完饭) 'after' is 以后. 后来 and 然后 cannot be attached to the end of a clause.

items.q: ___我每天都要锻炼，不再整天看电视了。
items.zh: 以后我每天都要锻炼，不再整天看电视了。
items.py: yǐ hòu wǒ měi tiān dōu yào duàn liàn bú zài zhěng tiān kàn diàn shì le
items.en: From now on I'm going to exercise every day and not watch TV all day long.
items.why: Looking forward, 'from now on', is 以后 alone. 后来 only looks back at the past and 然后 means 'and then'.

items.s: 纸是中国人发现的。
items.s_py: zhǐ shì zhōng guó rén fā xiàn de
items.zh: 纸是中国人发明的。
items.py: zhǐ shì zhōng guó rén fā míng de
items.en: Paper was invented by the Chinese.
items.why: Paper did not exist until someone made it, so it was 发明 'invented'. 发现 is for finding something that was already there, like a star or a mistake.

items.q: 出门___，别忘了关窗户。
items.zh: 出门以前，别忘了关窗户。
items.py: chū mén yǐ qián bié wàng le guān chuāng hu
items.en: Before you go out, don't forget to close the windows.
items.why: 'Before going out' is the clause 出门 plus 以前. 以后 would mean after leaving, when it is too late to close the windows.

items.q: 这位医生___了我很大的忙，我想请他吃饭。
items.zh: 这位医生帮了我很大的忙，我想请他吃饭。
items.py: zhè wèi yī shēng bāng le wǒ hěn dà de máng wǒ xiǎng qǐng tā chī fàn
items.en: This doctor was a great help to me, and I want to take him out for a meal.
items.why: The split 帮了我很大的忙 is 帮 + 了 + person + 的 + 忙. 帮忙了我很大的忙 repeats 忙 and 帮助了我很大的忙 does not take 的忙.

items.q: 都半夜了，邻居家___在放音乐。
items.zh: 都半夜了，邻居家还在放音乐。
items.py: dōu bàn yè le lín jū jiā hái zài fàng yīn yuè
items.en: It's already midnight and the neighbours are still playing music.
items.why: The music has not stopped, so 还在 'still'. 再 looks ahead to a repeat that has not begun, and cannot describe something still going on.

items.s: 我是学生以前，住在北京。
items.s_py: wǒ shì xué sheng yǐ qián zhù zài běi jīng
items.zh: 我是学生的时候，住在北京。
items.py: wǒ shì xué sheng de shí hou zhù zài běi jīng
items.en: When I was a student, I lived in Beijing.
items.why: 'When I was a student' is 的时候. 以前 after the clause means 'before I was a student', which is not the meaning.

items.q: 学会游泳___，我每个周末都去游泳池。
items.zh: 学会游泳以后，我每个周末都去游泳池。
items.py: xué huì yóu yǒng yǐ hòu wǒ měi gè zhōu mò dōu qù yóu yǒng chí
items.en: After I learned to swim, I went to the pool every weekend.
items.why: Right after the clause 学会游泳 'after' is 以后. 后来 and 然后 stand on their own and never close a clause.

items.q: 我妈妈住院了，我周末去医院___她。
items.zh: 我妈妈住院了，我周末去医院看望她。
items.py: wǒ mā ma zhù yuàn le wǒ zhōu mò qù yī yuàn kàn wàng tā
items.en: My mum is in hospital, so I'm going to see her at the weekend.
items.why: Going to see someone you care about is 看望. 参观 is for places you look round, so 参观她 is wrong.

items.q: 这条路今天___堵车了，我们得绕路。
items.zh: 这条路今天又堵车了，我们得绕路。
items.py: zhè tiáo lù jīn tiān yòu dǔ chē le wǒ men děi rào lù
items.en: The traffic is jammed on this road again today; we'll have to take a detour.
items.why: A jam that is happening again, already a fact today, takes 又 with 了. 再 looks ahead and 还 means 'still'.

items.s: 他说得很懂，我们都听明白了。
items.s_py: tā shuō de hěn dǒng wǒ men dōu tīng míng bai le
items.zh: 他说得很清楚，我们都听明白了。
items.py: tā shuō de hěn qīng chu wǒ men dōu tīng míng bai le
items.en: He spoke very clearly, and we all understood.
items.why: How clearly someone speaks is 清楚 after 得. 懂 describes the listener's understanding and cannot follow 说得很.

items.q: 他是新来的医生，还没有什么___，请你多帮帮他。
items.zh: 他是新来的医生，还没有什么经验，请你多帮帮他。
items.py: tā shì xīn lái de yī shēng hái méi yǒu shén me jīng yàn qǐng nǐ duō bāng bang tā
items.en: He's a new doctor without much experience yet, so please help him out.
items.why: Know-how gained from doing a job is 经验. 经历 is what happened to you, so 没有经历 would say he has not been through anything.

items.s: 明天我又来看你。
items.s_py: míng tiān wǒ yòu lái kàn nǐ
items.zh: 明天我再来看你。
items.py: míng tiān wǒ zài lái kàn nǐ
items.en: I'll come and see you again tomorrow.
items.why: Tomorrow has not happened, so a repeat takes 再. 又 is for a repeat that has already happened.

items.q: 对不起，我___忘带钥匙了。
items.zh: 对不起，我又忘带钥匙了。
items.py: duì bu qǐ wǒ yòu wàng dài yào shi le
items.en: Sorry, I've forgotten my keys again.
items.why: Forgetting happened already, so 又 with 了. 再 would need the forgetting to be still to come.

items.q: 你现在说这件事不太___。
items.zh: 你现在说这件事不太合适。
items.py: nǐ xiàn zài shuō zhè jiàn shì bú tài hé shì
items.en: It's not very appropriate for you to bring this up now.
items.why: Nothing follows as an object, and 不太 modifies an adjective: 不太合适. 适合 would need an object.

items.s: 他先买了票，然后进了电影院。
items.s_py: tā xiān mǎi le piào rán hòu jìn le diàn yǐng yuàn
items.zh: 他先买了票，然后进了电影院。
items.py: tā xiān mǎi le piào rán hòu jìn le diàn yǐng yuàn
items.en: He bought a ticket first, then went into the cinema.
items.why: 先 … 然后 links two steps in order, and it works for a past event too. 然后 starts its own clause here.

items.s: 这个决定太忽然了，我还没想好。
items.s_py: zhè ge jué dìng tài hū rán le wǒ hái méi xiǎng hǎo
items.zh: 这个决定太突然了，我还没想好。
items.py: zhè ge jué dìng tài tū rán le wǒ hái méi xiǎng hǎo
items.en: This decision is too sudden; I haven't made up my mind yet.
items.why: 太…了 needs an adjective, and only 突然 is one. 忽然 is only an adverb before a verb.

items.q: 我___楼上没有人住，原来住着一位老医生。
items.zh: 我以为楼上没有人住，原来住着一位老医生。
items.py: wǒ yǐ wéi lóu shàng méi yǒu rén zhù yuán lái zhù zhe yí wèi lǎo yī shēng
items.en: I thought no one lived upstairs, but it turns out an old doctor lives there.
items.why: 原来 reveals the belief was wrong, so 以为. 觉得 would present 'no one lives there' as an opinion that stays valid.

items.s: 请你又说一遍，我没听懂。
items.s_py: qǐng nǐ yòu shuō yí biàn wǒ méi tīng dǒng
items.zh: 请你再说一遍，我没听懂。
items.py: qǐng nǐ zài shuō yí biàn wǒ méi tīng dǒng
items.en: Please say it again; I didn't understand.
items.why: A request asks for something still to come, so 再. 又 cannot go in a request.

items.q: 很高兴___你！
items.zh: 很高兴认识你！
items.py: hěn gāo xìng rèn shi nǐ
items.en: Nice to meet you!
items.why: Getting acquainted with a person you are meeting now is 认识. 知道你 would only say you have heard of the person, so it cannot be a greeting.

items.q: 他上大学___，在一家音乐商店打工。
items.zh: 他上大学的时候，在一家音乐商店打工。
items.py: tā shàng dà xué de shí hou zài yì jiā yīn yuè shāng diàn dǎ gōng
items.en: When he was at university, he worked part-time in a music shop.
items.why: The English says 'when he was at university', a period of time: 的时候. 以前 would put the job before university and 以后 after it.

items.s: 出门时请带上钥匙。
items.s_py: chū mén shí qǐng dài shàng yào shi
items.zh: 出门时请带上钥匙。
items.py: chū mén shí qǐng dài shàng yào shi
items.en: Please take your keys when you go out.
items.why: 时 is the short, written form of 的时候 and attaches straight to the verb phrase. It is correct with no 的.

items.s: 这件事我不太清楚，你去问问他吧。
items.s_py: zhè jiàn shì wǒ bú tài qīng chu nǐ qù wèn wen tā ba
items.zh: 这件事我不太清楚，你去问问他吧。
items.py: zhè jiàn shì wǒ bú tài qīng chu nǐ qù wèn wen tā ba
items.en: I'm not too sure about this; go and ask him.
items.why: 我不太清楚 is the normal way to say you do not know the details of a matter. 清楚 here means 'clear in my mind', not 'clear to the eye'.

items.q: 回家___给我打个电话。
items.zh: 回家以后给我打个电话。
items.py: huí jiā yǐ hòu gěi wǒ dǎ ge diàn huà
items.en: Call me after you get home.
items.why: 'After getting home' is the clause 回家 plus 以后. 后来 is past-only and 然后 cannot be attached to a clause.

items.q: 他看不___黑板上的字，所以坐到了前面。
items.zh: 他看不清楚黑板上的字，所以坐到了前面。
items.py: tā kàn bù qīng chu hēi bǎn shàng de zì suǒ yǐ zuò dào le qián miàn
items.en: He couldn't see the words on the blackboard clearly, so he moved to the front.
items.why: Moving to the front shows the problem is seeing, so 看不清楚. 看不懂 would mean he cannot grasp the meaning, which a seat would not fix.

items.q: 他在中国住了五年，当然___汉语。
items.zh: 他在中国住了五年，当然懂汉语。
items.py: tā zài zhōng guó zhù le wǔ nián dāng rán dǒng hàn yǔ
items.en: He has lived in China for five years, so of course he knows Chinese.
items.why: Knowing a language is 懂 plus the language. 明白汉语 and 清楚汉语 are not used for a language.

items.q: 在邮局第一次见面，很高兴___你。
items.zh: 在邮局第一次见面，很高兴认识你。
items.py: zài yóu jú dì yī cì jiàn miàn hěn gāo xìng rèn shi nǐ
items.en: We met at the post office for the first time. Nice to meet you.
items.why: Meeting a person and becoming acquainted is 认识 (很高兴认识你). 知道 only means you know a fact or who someone is, and 了解 means knowing in depth, which a first meeting cannot give.

items.q: 你___银行在哪儿吗？
items.zh: 你知道银行在哪儿吗？
items.py: nǐ zhī dào yín háng zài nǎ r ma
items.en: Do you know where the bank is?
items.why: The object is a fact (where the bank is), so 知道. 认识 is for people, characters and roads, and 了解 would mean knowing the bank in depth.

items.q: 他在中国住了十年，很___中国的节日。
items.zh: 他在中国住了十年，很了解中国的节日。
items.py: tā zài zhōng guó zhù le shí nián hěn liǎo jiě zhōng guó de jié rì
items.en: He has lived in China for ten years and knows Chinese festivals very well.
items.why: Knowing something in depth, with degree word 很, is 了解. 知道 and 认识 never take 很.

items.q: 这个汉字我不___，你能读给我听吗？
items.zh: 这个汉字我不认识，你能读给我听吗？
items.py: zhè ge hàn zì wǒ bù rèn shi nǐ néng dú gěi wǒ tīng ma
items.en: I don't recognise this character. Can you read it to me?
items.why: Recognising a written character is 认识. 了解 means to understand a topic or person in depth and cannot be used for a single character.

items.q: 他___明天银行不开门，所以今天来取钱了。
items.zh: 他知道明天银行不开门，所以今天来取钱了。
items.py: tā zhī dào míng tiān yín háng bù kāi mén suǒ yǐ jīn tiān lái qǔ qián le
items.en: He knew the bank would be closed tomorrow, so he came to withdraw money today.
items.why: A clause (the bank will be closed tomorrow) is a fact, so 知道. 认识 takes a person or character, and 了解 would suggest deep knowledge of the matter.

items.q: 在网上买东西以前，我会先___一下这家店的情况。
items.zh: 在网上买东西以前，我会先了解一下这家店的情况。
items.py: zài wǎng shàng mǎi dōng xi yǐ qián wǒ huì xiān liǎo jiě yí xià zhè jiā diàn de qíng kuàng
items.en: Before shopping online I first find out about the shop.
items.why: 了解一下 means to look into and get to know a situation. 认识 is for people and 知道一下 is not said; a person cannot 认识 a shop's situation.

items.q: 小王去年在球场上___了很多朋友。
items.zh: 小王去年在球场上认识了很多朋友。
items.py: xiǎo wáng qù nián zài qiú chǎng shàng rèn shi le hěn duō péng you
items.en: Last year Xiao Wang got to know many friends on the pitch.
items.why: Meeting people and becoming acquainted with them is 认识了很多朋友. 知道 would only mean knowing who they are, and 了解 means knowing someone in depth, not making new friends.

items.s: 我很知道这个城市的历史。
items.s_py: wǒ hěn zhī dào zhè ge chéng shì de lì shǐ
items.zh: 我很了解这个城市的历史。
items.py: wǒ hěn liǎo jiě zhè ge chéng shì de lì shǐ
items.en: I know the history of this city very well.
items.why: 知道 never takes 很. Knowing a topic well is 了解.

items.s: 我不认识今天的作业是什么。
items.s_py: wǒ bù rèn shi jīn tiān de zuò yè shì shén me
items.zh: 我不知道今天的作业是什么。
items.py: wǒ bù zhī dào jīn tiān de zuò yè shì shén me
items.en: I don't know what today's homework is.
items.why: What the homework is, is a fact, so 知道. 认识 only takes people, characters and roads.

items.q: 他说话声音太小，我听不___。
items.zh: 他说话声音太小，我听不清楚。
items.py: tā shuō huà shēng yīn tài xiǎo wǒ tīng bù qīng chu
items.en: He speaks so quietly that I can't hear him clearly.
items.why: A voice that is too quiet is a problem of hearing clearly, so 听不清楚. 听不懂 means you heard but could not grasp the meaning.

items.q: 我妈妈不___英语，所以我们说中文。
items.zh: 我妈妈不懂英语，所以我们说中文。
items.py: wǒ mā ma bù dǒng yīng yǔ suǒ yǐ wǒ men shuō zhōng wén
items.en: My mum doesn't know English, so we speak Chinese.
items.why: Knowing a language is 懂 + language. 清楚 means clear and cannot take a language as object.

items.q: 黑板上的字太小，我看不___。
items.zh: 黑板上的字太小，我看不清楚。
items.py: hēi bǎn shàng de zì tài xiǎo wǒ kàn bù qīng chu
items.en: The writing on the blackboard is too small; I can't see it clearly.
items.why: Writing that is too small is a problem of seeing clearly: 看不清楚. 看不懂 would mean you could see it but not understand it.

items.q: 银行的人把办卡的方法说得很___，我一听就会了。
items.zh: 银行的人把办卡的方法说得很清楚，我一听就会了。
items.py: yín háng de rén bǎ bàn kǎ de fāng fǎ shuō de hěn qīng chu wǒ yì tīng jiù huì le
items.en: The bank clerk explained how to get a card so clearly that I got it at once.
items.why: How clearly someone speaks is 说得很清楚. 懂 is what the listener does and cannot describe the speaking.

items.q: 这件事的经过我不太___，你去问小王吧。
items.zh: 这件事的经过我不太清楚，你去问小王吧。
items.py: zhè jiàn shì de jīng guò wǒ bú tài qīng chu nǐ qù wèn xiǎo wáng ba
items.en: I'm not very sure how this came about; go and ask Xiao Wang.
items.why: 不太清楚 means 'not sure of the facts', which fits asking someone else. 懂 is for grasping meaning or a skill, not for knowing the course of events.

items.q: 我不___日语，所以看不了这本书。
items.zh: 我不懂日语，所以看不了这本书。
items.py: wǒ bù dǒng rì yǔ suǒ yǐ kàn bu liǎo zhè běn shū
items.en: I don't know Japanese, so I can't read this book.
items.why: Knowing a language is 懂 + language. 清楚 and 明白 cannot take a language as object.

items.q: 他对这家银行的规定了解得很___，所以大家都爱问他。
items.zh: 他对这家银行的规定了解得很清楚，所以大家都爱问他。
items.py: tā duì zhè jiā yín háng de guī dìng liǎo jiě de hěn qīng chu suǒ yǐ dà jiā dōu ài wèn tā
items.en: He knows the bank's rules inside out, so everyone likes to ask him.
items.why: 了解得很清楚 means knowing the details clearly. 懂 does not follow 了解得.

items.s: 老师说得很懂，我们都喜欢听他的课。
items.s_py: lǎo shī shuō de hěn dǒng wǒ men dōu xǐ huan tīng tā de kè
items.zh: 老师说得很清楚，我们都喜欢听他的课。
items.py: lǎo shī shuō de hěn qīng chu wǒ men dōu xǐ huan tīng tā de kè
items.en: The teacher explains things very clearly, and we all like to listen to his lessons.
items.why: How clearly someone speaks is 说得很清楚. 懂 describes the listener and cannot follow 说得很.

items.s: 这张表我看清楚了，可是没看懂。
items.s_py: zhè zhāng biǎo wǒ kàn qīng chu le kě shì méi kàn dǒng
items.zh: 这张表我看清楚了，可是没看懂。
items.py: zhè zhāng biǎo wǒ kàn qīng chu le kě shì méi kàn dǒng
items.en: I could see this form clearly, but I couldn't make sense of it.
items.why: 看清楚 is seeing clearly and 看懂 is making sense of it, so the two can be set against each other.

items.s: 我不清楚法语，所以听不懂。
items.s_py: wǒ bù qīng chu fǎ yǔ suǒ yǐ tīng bù dǒng
items.zh: 我不懂法语，所以听不懂。
items.py: wǒ bù dǒng fǎ yǔ suǒ yǐ tīng bù dǒng
items.en: I don't know French, so I can't understand it.
items.why: Knowing a language is 懂 + language. 清楚 cannot take a language as object.

items.q: 昨天他迟到了，今天___迟到了。
items.zh: 昨天他迟到了，今天又迟到了。
items.py: zuó tiān tā chí dào le jīn tiān yòu chí dào le
items.en: He was late yesterday and was late again today.
items.why: The repeat has already happened (迟到了), so 又. 再 is for a repeat that has not happened yet.

items.q: 这本书很好，我想明天___看一遍。
items.zh: 这本书很好，我想明天再看一遍。
items.py: zhè běn shū hěn hǎo wǒ xiǎng míng tiān zài kàn yí biàn
items.en: This book is good; I want to read it again tomorrow.
items.why: A repeat planned for tomorrow takes 再: 明天再看一遍. 又 is for a repeat that has already happened.

items.q: 我还没吃饱，想___吃一碗饭。
items.zh: 我还没吃饱，想再吃一碗饭。
items.py: wǒ hái méi chī bǎo xiǎng zài chī yì wǎn fàn
items.en: I'm still hungry; I'd like to eat another bowl of rice.
items.why: Another bowl you have not eaten yet is a repeat still to come, so 想再吃一碗. 又 would mean the extra bowl has already been eaten.

items.q: 邮局中午休息，你下午两点___来吧。
items.zh: 邮局中午休息，你下午两点再来吧。
items.py: yóu jú zhōng wǔ xiū xi nǐ xià wǔ liǎng diǎn zài lái ba
items.en: The post office is closed at noon; come back at two in the afternoon.
items.why: A request about a future return is 再. 又 would need the return to have happened already.

items.q: 都十点了，他___没起床。
items.zh: 都十点了，他还没起床。
items.py: dōu shí diǎn le tā hái méi qǐ chuáng
items.en: It's already ten o'clock and he still hasn't got up.
items.why: 还 + 没 means 'still not yet'. 再 cannot stand before 没 to mean 'still'.

items.q: 上个月他刚去过上海，这个月___去了。
items.zh: 上个月他刚去过上海，这个月又去了。
items.py: shàng ge yuè tā gāng qù guò shàng hǎi zhè ge yuè yòu qù le
items.en: He went to Shanghai last month, and this month he has gone again.
items.why: The repeat has happened (去了), so 又. 再 would need the second trip to still lie ahead.

items.q: 雨下了一个上午，现在___在下。
items.zh: 雨下了一个上午，现在还在下。
items.py: yǔ xià le yí ge shàng wǔ xiàn zài hái zài xià
items.en: It has rained all morning and it's still raining now.
items.why: Something that has not stopped is 还在 + verb, 'still'. 再 is for a repeat that has not happened yet and cannot go before 在 to mean 'still'.

items.s: 周末我们又去公园玩吧。
items.s_py: zhōu mò wǒ men yòu qù gōng yuán wán ba
items.zh: 周末我们再去公园玩吧。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ men zài qù gōng yuán wán ba
items.en: Let's go to the park again at the weekend.
items.why: A suggestion about the future takes 再. 又 only fits repeats that have already happened.

items.s: 明天又是星期一了，真不想上班。
items.s_py: míng tiān yòu shì xīng qī yī le zhēn bù xiǎng shàng bān
items.zh: 明天又是星期一了，真不想上班。
items.py: míng tiān yòu shì xīng qī yī le zhēn bù xiǎng shàng bān
items.en: Tomorrow is Monday again; I really don't want to go to work.
items.why: 又 can look ahead to a repeat that is certain to come, especially in 又是…了, so this is correct.

items.s: 对不起，我没听清楚，请你又说一遍。
items.s_py: duì bu qǐ wǒ méi tīng qīng chu qǐng nǐ yòu shuō yí biàn
items.zh: 对不起，我没听清楚，请你再说一遍。
items.py: duì bu qǐ wǒ méi tīng qīng chu qǐng nǐ zài shuō yí biàn
items.en: Sorry, I didn't hear clearly; please say it again.
items.why: A request for a repeat still to come is 再说一遍. 又 cannot be used in a request.

items.q: 下课___，我要去银行。
items.zh: 下课以后，我要去银行。
items.py: xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ yào qù yín háng
items.en: After class I'm going to the bank.
items.why: 'After X' is clause + 以后. 后来 and 然后 cannot be attached to 下课.

items.q: 我先去邮局寄信，___去超市买菜。
items.zh: 我先去邮局寄信，然后去超市买菜。
items.py: wǒ xiān qù yóu jú jì xìn rán hòu qù chāo shì mǎi cài
items.en: I'll first post a letter at the post office, then go to the supermarket to buy food.
items.why: 先…然后… marks the next step in a plan. 后来 only looks back on a past story, and 以后 needs a clause in front of it.

items.q: 他去年学过画画，___因为太忙就不学了。
items.zh: 他去年学过画画，后来因为太忙就不学了。
items.py: tā qù nián xué guò huà huà hòu lái yīn wèi tài máng jiù bù xué le
items.en: He studied painting last year, but later he was too busy and stopped.
items.why: 后来 opens a later part of a past story and stands alone. 以后 on its own looks forward ('from now on'), so it cannot carry a past story on.

items.q: ___我每个月都要存一些钱，不能再乱花了。
items.zh: 以后我每个月都要存一些钱，不能再乱花了。
items.py: yǐ hòu wǒ měi ge yuè dōu yào cún yì xiē qián bù néng zài luàn huā le
items.en: From now on I must save some money every month and stop spending carelessly.
items.why: 以后 at the start means 'from now on' and looks forward. 后来 only describes the past.

items.q: 过了春节___，商店里的人就少了。
items.zh: 过了春节以后，商店里的人就少了。
items.py: guò le chūn jié yǐ hòu shāng diàn lǐ de rén jiù shǎo le
items.en: After the Spring Festival there are fewer people in the shops.
items.why: 'After X' is clause + 以后. 然后 and 后来 cannot be attached to 过了春节.

items.q: 他们考上不同的大学___，就很少见面了。
items.zh: 他们考上不同的大学以后，就很少见面了。
items.py: tā men kǎo shàng bù tóng de dà xué yǐ hòu jiù hěn shǎo jiàn miàn le
items.en: After they got into different universities they seldom met.
items.why: Clause + 以后 means 'after X': 考上不同的大学以后. 后来 never attaches to a clause; it stands alone at the start of a later part of a story.

items.q: 你先把表填好，___交给柜台的工作人员。
items.zh: 你先把表填好，然后交给柜台的工作人员。
items.py: nǐ xiān bǎ biǎo tián hǎo rán hòu jiāo gěi guì tái de gōng zuò rén yuán
items.en: First fill in the form, then hand it to the staff at the counter.
items.why: 先…然后… gives the next step of an instruction. 后来 is for past stories only, and 以后 needs a clause in front of it.

items.s: 下课后来，我们去打篮球吧。
items.s_py: xià kè hòu lái wǒ men qù dǎ lán qiú ba
items.zh: 下课以后，我们去打篮球吧。
items.py: xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ men qù dǎ lán qiú ba
items.en: After class let's go and play basketball.
items.why: 'After class' is 下课以后. 后来 cannot follow a clause and never looks to the future.

items.s: 他小时候在上海住过，后来搬到了北京。
items.s_py: tā xiǎo shí hou zài shàng hǎi zhù guò hòu lái bān dào le běi jīng
items.zh: 他小时候在上海住过，后来搬到了北京。
items.py: tā xiǎo shí hou zài shàng hǎi zhù guò hòu lái bān dào le běi jīng
items.en: He lived in Shanghai as a child and later moved to Beijing.
items.why: 后来 stands alone at the start of the second clause of a past story, which is exactly its use.

items.s: 以后你要多锻炼身体。
items.s_py: yǐ hòu nǐ yào duō duàn liàn shēn tǐ
items.zh: 以后你要多锻炼身体。
items.py: yǐ hòu nǐ yào duō duàn liàn shēn tǐ
items.en: From now on you should exercise more.
items.why: 以后 alone at the start means 'from now on' and is correct for advice about the future.

items.q: 我小___，家在上海。
items.zh: 我小的时候，家在上海。
items.py: wǒ xiǎo de shí hou jiā zài shàng hǎi
items.en: When I was little, my home was in Shanghai.
items.why: 'When I was little' is 我小的时候. 以前 cannot follow 小 to mean 'when'.

items.q: 开车___不能打电话。
items.zh: 开车时不能打电话。
items.py: kāi chē shí bù néng dǎ diàn huà
items.en: You must not use the phone while driving.
items.why: 'While driving' is clause + 时 (the written form of 的时候). 以前 would mean 'before driving'.

items.q: 他在看电视___，妈妈在厨房做饭。
items.zh: 他在看电视的时候，妈妈在厨房做饭。
items.py: tā zài kàn diàn shì de shí hou mā ma zài chú fáng zuò fàn
items.en: While he was watching TV, mum was cooking in the kitchen.
items.why: Two things going on at the same time: clause + 的时候. 以前 means 'before' and does not fit 在看电视.

items.q: 考试结束___，我们才能离开教室。
items.zh: 考试结束以后，我们才能离开教室。
items.py: kǎo shì jié shù yǐ hòu wǒ men cái néng lí kāi jiào shì
items.en: We may only leave the classroom after the exam is over.
items.why: 才 marks the earliest moment allowed, which is after the exam ends: 以后. 以前 would say we may not leave before it ends, with no 才.

items.q: 我喜欢在睡觉___看一会儿书。
items.zh: 我喜欢在睡觉以前看一会儿书。
items.py: wǒ xǐ huan zài shuì jiào yǐ qián kàn yí huì r shū
items.en: I like to read for a while before going to sleep.
items.why: Reading before sleep is 睡觉以前. 睡觉以后 would mean after falling asleep, which cannot be done.

items.q: 我还在上大学___，妈妈每个月都会给我寄一些钱。
items.zh: 我还在上大学的时候，妈妈每个月都会给我寄一些钱。
items.py: wǒ hái zài shàng dà xué de shí hou mā ma měi ge yuè dōu huì gěi wǒ jì yì xiē qián
items.en: When I was still at university, my mum sent me some money every month.
items.why: 'When' is clause + 的时候. 以前 means 'before' and does not combine with 还在上大学.

items.q: 我___不喜欢喝咖啡，现在每天都喝。
items.zh: 我以前不喜欢喝咖啡，现在每天都喝。
items.py: wǒ yǐ qián bù xǐ huan hē kā fēi xiàn zài měi tiān dōu hē
items.en: I didn't use to like coffee, but now I drink it every day.
items.why: 以前 alone means 'in the past', contrasted with 现在. 以后 looks forward, and 的时候 needs a clause.

items.s: 我小以前住在上海。
items.s_py: wǒ xiǎo yǐ qián zhù zài shàng hǎi
items.zh: 我小的时候住在上海。
items.py: wǒ xiǎo de shí hou zhù zài shàng hǎi
items.en: When I was little I lived in Shanghai.
items.why: 'When I was little' is 我小的时候. 以前 means 'before' and cannot follow 小.

items.s: 下班时，银行门口有很多人。
items.s_py: xià bān shí yín háng mén kǒu yǒu hěn duō rén
items.zh: 下班时，银行门口有很多人。
items.py: xià bān shí yín háng mén kǒu yǒu hěn duō rén
items.en: When people finish work, there are lots of people at the bank's door.
items.why: 时 is the written form of 的时候 and attaches straight to the verb phrase, with the time clause first.

items.s: 我以前不会游泳，现在每个星期都去游泳。
items.s_py: wǒ yǐ qián bú huì yóu yǒng xiàn zài měi ge xīng qī dōu qù yóu yǒng
items.zh: 我以前不会游泳，现在每个星期都去游泳。
items.py: wǒ yǐ qián bú huì yóu yǒng xiàn zài měi ge xīng qī dōu qù yóu yǒng
items.en: I couldn't swim before, but now I go swimming every week.
items.why: 以前 alone means 'in the past' and sits after the subject; it is correct here.

items.q: 你能___我拿一下行李吗？
items.zh: 你能帮我拿一下行李吗？
items.py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ ná yí xià xíng li ma
items.en: Could you hold my luggage for me for a moment?
items.why: 帮 + person + verb is everyday help. 帮忙 already contains its object 忙 and cannot take 我.

items.q: 请你___个忙，好吗？
items.zh: 请你帮个忙，好吗？
items.py: qǐng nǐ bāng ge máng hǎo ma
items.en: Could you do me a favour?
items.why: 帮个忙 uses 帮 with the object 忙 split off. 帮助 and 帮忙 cannot be followed by another 忙.

items.q: 谢谢你的___，我一个人真的做不完。
items.zh: 谢谢你的帮助，我一个人真的做不完。
items.py: xiè xie nǐ de bāng zhù wǒ yí ge rén zhēn de zuò bu wán
items.en: Thank you for your help; I really couldn't finish by myself.
items.why: After 你的 a noun is needed, and 帮助 is also the noun 'help'. 帮 is only a verb.

items.q: 周末我去朋友家___，他要搬家。
items.zh: 周末我去朋友家帮忙，他要搬家。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ qù péng you jiā bāng máng tā yào bān jiā
items.en: At the weekend I'm going to my friend's place to help, as he's moving house.
items.why: With no person object, 帮忙 stands whole as 'lend a hand'. 帮助 needs an object.

items.q: 邮局的人___我把包裹寄到了上海。
items.zh: 邮局的人帮我把包裹寄到了上海。
items.py: yóu jú de rén bāng wǒ bǎ bāo guǒ jì dào le shàng hǎi
items.en: The post office clerk helped me send the parcel to Shanghai.
items.why: 帮 + person + verb phrase. 帮忙 cannot take 我 as an object.

items.q: 老师常常___学习不好的同学。
items.zh: 老师常常帮助学习不好的同学。
items.py: lǎo shī cháng cháng bāng zhù xué xí bù hǎo de tóng xué
items.en: The teacher often helps students who do badly in their studies.
items.why: 帮助 takes a person as direct object. 帮忙 never takes an object.

items.q: 他在银行工作，上个星期帮了我一个很大的___。
items.zh: 他在银行工作，上个星期帮了我一个很大的忙。
items.py: tā zài yín háng gōng zuò shàng ge xīng qī bāng le wǒ yí ge hěn dà de máng
items.en: He works at a bank and last week did me a big favour.
items.why: 帮忙 is verb + object, so it splits: 帮了我一个很大的忙. 帮忙 or 帮助 cannot fill the object slot after 一个很大的.

items.s: 我帮忙你找钱包。
items.s_py: wǒ bāng máng nǐ zhǎo qián bāo
items.zh: 我帮你找钱包。
items.py: wǒ bāng nǐ zhǎo qián bāo
items.en: I'll help you look for your wallet.
items.why: 帮忙 already has its object 忙 and cannot take 你. Say 帮你找 or 帮你的忙.

items.s: 同学们都愿意帮助他。
items.s_py: tóng xué men dōu yuàn yì bāng zhù tā
items.zh: 同学们都愿意帮助他。
items.py: tóng xué men dōu yuàn yì bāng zhù tā
items.en: All the classmates are willing to help him.
items.why: 帮助 takes a person as direct object, so 帮助他 is correct.

items.s: 谢谢你的帮，我很高兴。
items.s_py: xiè xie nǐ de bāng wǒ hěn gāo xìng
items.zh: 谢谢你的帮助，我很高兴。
items.py: xiè xie nǐ de bāng zhù wǒ hěn gāo xìng
items.en: Thank you for your help; I'm very glad.
items.why: After 你的 a noun is needed. 帮 is only a verb; the noun is 帮助.

items.q: 我___你不会来了，原来你在这儿。
items.zh: 我以为你不会来了，原来你在这儿。
items.py: wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ bú huì lái le yuán lái nǐ zài zhè r
items.en: I thought you weren't coming, but you're here.
items.why: 原来 shows the belief was wrong, so 以为. 认为 states a considered view that the speaker still holds and does not fit a reversal.

items.q: 跑了一个小时，我___很累。
items.zh: 跑了一个小时，我觉得很累。
items.py: pǎo le yí ge xiǎo shí wǒ jué de hěn lèi
items.en: After running for an hour I feel very tired.
items.why: A bodily feeling is 觉得. 认为 is never used for body feelings, and 以为 means a mistaken belief.

items.q: 喝了这杯热茶，我___舒服多了。
items.zh: 喝了这杯热茶，我觉得舒服多了。
items.py: hē le zhè bēi rè chá wǒ jué de shū fu duō le
items.en: After this cup of hot tea I feel much better.
items.why: A bodily feeling is 觉得. 认为 does not express how you feel physically.

items.q: 你___这件衣服怎么样？
items.zh: 你觉得这件衣服怎么样？
items.py: nǐ jué de zhè jiàn yī fu zěn me yàng
items.en: What do you think of this top?
items.why: Asking for an opinion is 你觉得…怎么样. 以为 means a belief that turned out false.

items.q: 我___小王是学生，原来他是体育老师。
items.zh: 我以为小王是学生，原来他是体育老师。
items.py: wǒ yǐ wéi xiǎo wáng shì xué sheng yuán lái tā shì tǐ yù lǎo shī
items.en: I thought Xiao Wang was a student, but he's actually the PE teacher.
items.why: 原来 reveals that the belief was false, so 以为. 认为 is a considered judgement you still hold and clashes with 原来.

items.q: 很多专家___，每天运动半个小时对身体最好。
items.zh: 很多专家认为，每天运动半个小时对身体最好。
items.py: hěn duō zhuān jiā rèn wéi měi tiān yùn dòng bàn ge xiǎo shí duì shēn tǐ zuì hǎo
items.en: Many experts think that half an hour of exercise a day is best for the body.
items.why: An expert's considered judgement is 认为. 以为 would say they were wrong.

items.q: 我___这双球鞋要两千块，原来只要两百块。
items.zh: 我以为这双球鞋要两千块，原来只要两百块。
items.py: wǒ yǐ wéi zhè shuāng qiú xié yào liǎng qiān kuài yuán lái zhǐ yào liǎng bǎi kuài
items.en: I thought these trainers cost two thousand yuan, but they cost only two hundred.
items.why: 原来 shows the guess was wrong, so 以为. 认为 states a judgement you still hold and does not fit a reversal.

items.s: 我以为今天有课，其实没有。
items.s_py: wǒ yǐ wéi jīn tiān yǒu kè qí shí méi yǒu
items.zh: 我以为今天有课，其实没有。
items.py: wǒ yǐ wéi jīn tiān yǒu kè qí shí méi yǒu
items.en: I thought there was a class today, but there isn't.
items.why: 以为 is right because 其实 shows the belief was wrong.

items.s: 我认为你已经回家了，原来你还在学校。
items.s_py: wǒ rèn wéi nǐ yǐ jīng huí jiā le yuán lái nǐ hái zài xué xiào
items.zh: 我以为你已经回家了，原来你还在学校。
items.py: wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ yǐ jīng huí jiā le yuán lái nǐ hái zài xué xiào
items.en: I thought you'd already gone home, but you're still at school.
items.why: 原来 shows the belief was false, so it must be 以为. 认为 states a view you still hold.

items.q: 周末我想去医院___奶奶。
items.zh: 周末我想去医院看望奶奶。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng qù yī yuàn kàn wàng nǎi nai
items.en: At the weekend I want to go to the hospital to see grandma.
items.why: A person you care about is visited with 看望. 参观 is for places, and 访问 is an official visit.

items.q: 我们明天去博物馆___。
items.zh: 我们明天去博物馆参观。
items.py: wǒ men míng tiān qù bó wù guǎn cān guān
items.en: We're going to look round the museum tomorrow.
items.why: A museum is a place you look round: 参观. 看望 is for people and 访问 is official.

items.q: 暑假我们去海南___。
items.zh: 暑假我们去海南旅游。
items.py: shǔ jià wǒ men qù hǎi nán lǚ yóu
items.en: In the summer holiday we're going to Hainan for a holiday.
items.why: 去 + place + 旅游 is going somewhere on holiday. 参观 is for looking round one site such as a museum or factory, not a holiday in a whole province, and 看望 needs a person.

items.q: 老师带我们去工厂___，看看工人怎么工作。
items.zh: 老师带我们去工厂参观，看看工人怎么工作。
items.py: lǎo shī dài wǒ men qù gōng chǎng cān guān kàn kan gōng rén zěn me gōng zuò
items.en: The teacher took us to look round a factory and see how the workers work.
items.why: Looking round a factory is 参观. 看望 is only for visiting people.

items.q: 小李病了，下班以后我们一起去___他吧。
items.zh: 小李病了，下班以后我们一起去看望他吧。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ bìng le xià bān yǐ hòu wǒ men yì qǐ qù kàn wàng tā ba
items.en: Xiao Li is ill; let's go and see him after work.
items.why: A sick friend is visited with 看望. 参观 is for places, 访问 is official.

items.q: 你可以___这个网站，上面有很多旅游信息。
items.zh: 你可以访问这个网站，上面有很多旅游信息。
items.py: nǐ kě yǐ fǎng wèn zhè ge wǎng zhàn shàng miàn yǒu hěn duō lǚ yóu xìn xī
items.en: You can visit this website; it has lots of travel information.
items.why: Going to a website is 访问. 看望 is only for people.

items.q: 中国的李教授下个月要去法国___，和那里的大学交流。
items.zh: 中国的李教授下个月要去法国访问，和那里的大学交流。
items.py: zhōng guó de lǐ jiào shòu xià ge yuè yào qù fǎ guó fǎng wèn hé nà lǐ de dà xué jiāo liú
items.en: Professor Li from China will go on an official visit to France next month to exchange ideas with universities there.
items.why: An official visit to a country is 访问. 看望 is for relatives and friends.

items.s: 春节我要去参观我的外婆。
items.s_py: chūn jié wǒ yào qù cān guān wǒ de wài pó
items.zh: 春节我要去看望我的外婆。
items.py: chūn jié wǒ yào qù kàn wàng wǒ de wài pó
items.en: At the Spring Festival I'm going to see my grandmother.
items.why: A person is visited with 看望. 参观 is for places you look round.

items.s: 我们暑假去北京旅游了一个星期。
items.s_py: wǒ men shǔ jià qù běi jīng lǚ yóu le yí ge xīng qī
items.zh: 我们暑假去北京旅游了一个星期。
items.py: wǒ men shǔ jià qù běi jīng lǚ yóu le yí ge xīng qī
items.en: We spent a week on holiday in Beijing in the summer.
items.why: 去 + place + 旅游 is the correct pattern; the place comes after 去.

items.s: 去年国庆节我们旅游了上海。
items.s_py: qù nián guó qìng jié wǒ men lǚ yóu le shàng hǎi
items.zh: 去年国庆节我们去上海旅游了。
items.py: qù nián guó qìng jié wǒ men qù shàng hǎi lǚ yóu le
items.en: Last National Day we went to Shanghai on holiday.
items.why: 旅游 takes no place object. The place goes after 去: 去上海旅游.

items.q: 这双鞋我穿太大了，不___。
items.zh: 这双鞋我穿太大了，不合适。
items.py: zhè shuāng xié wǒ chuān tài dà le bù hé shì
items.en: These shoes are too big for me; they don't fit properly.
items.why: With no object after it the adjective 合适 is needed. 适合 is a verb and must be followed by an object.

items.q: 这件红衣服很___你。
items.zh: 这件红衣服很适合你。
items.py: zhè jiàn hóng yī fu hěn shì hé nǐ
items.en: This red top really suits you.
items.why: An object (你) follows, so the verb 适合. 合适 is an adjective and cannot take an object.

items.q: 这条裤子大小正___，我就买这条吧。
items.zh: 这条裤子大小正合适，我就买这条吧。
items.py: zhè tiáo kù zi dà xiǎo zhèng hé shì wǒ jiù mǎi zhè tiáo ba
items.en: These trousers are just the right size, so I'll take them.
items.why: 正合适 'just right' uses the adjective, with nothing after it. 适合 is a verb and needs an object, as in 正适合你.

items.q: 这个消息来得太___了，我们都没有准备。
items.zh: 这个消息来得太突然了，我们都没有准备。
items.py: zhè ge xiāo xi lái de tài tū rán le wǒ men dōu méi yǒu zhǔn bèi
items.en: This news came so suddenly that none of us was prepared.
items.why: 太…了 needs an adjective, and only 突然 is also an adjective. 忽然 is only an adverb.

items.q: 他做了二十年老师，教学很有___。
items.zh: 他做了二十年老师，教学很有经验。
items.py: tā zuò le èr shí nián lǎo shī jiào xué hěn yǒu jīng yàn
items.en: He has been a teacher for twenty years and has a lot of teaching experience.
items.why: Know-how built up by doing is 经验. 经历 is what you went through, not skill.

items.q: 他年轻的时候___过很多困难，所以特别能吃苦。
items.zh: 他年轻的时候经历过很多困难，所以特别能吃苦。
items.py: tā nián qīng de shí hou jīng lì guò hěn duō kùn nan suǒ yǐ tè bié néng chī kǔ
items.en: He went through a lot of hardship when he was young, so he can endure a great deal.
items.why: 'Go through' is the verb 经历. 经验 is only a noun and cannot take 过.

items.q: 这次出国旅行是一次难忘的___。
items.zh: 这次出国旅行是一次难忘的经历。
items.py: zhè cì chū guó lǚ xíng shì yí cì nán wàng de jīng lì
items.en: This trip abroad was an unforgettable experience.
items.why: Something that happened to you is an 经历: 一次难忘的经历. In mainland usage 经验 is the know-how you gain, not the event itself.

items.s: 这个颜色不太合适我。
items.s_py: zhè ge yán sè bú tài hé shì wǒ
items.zh: 这个颜色不太适合我。
items.py: zhè ge yán sè bú tài shì hé wǒ
items.en: This colour doesn't really suit me.
items.why: 合适 is an adjective and takes no object. With 我 after it you need 适合.

items.s: 这个手机的价格对学生很合适。
items.s_py: zhè ge shǒu jī de jià gé duì xué sheng hěn hé shì
items.zh: 这个手机的价格对学生很合适。
items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī de jià gé duì xué sheng hěn hé shì
items.en: The price of this phone is just right for students.
items.why: 合适 stands without an object here, with 对学生 before it, so the adjective is correct.

items.s: 这件事太忽然了，我们都没想到。
items.s_py: zhè jiàn shì tài hū rán le wǒ men dōu méi xiǎng dào
items.zh: 这件事太突然了，我们都没想到。
items.py: zhè jiàn shì tài tū rán le wǒ men dōu méi xiǎng dào
items.en: This is so sudden; none of us expected it.
items.why: 太…了 needs an adjective. 突然 can be an adjective; 忽然 is only an adverb before verbs.

items.q: 我___钱包不见了。
items.zh: 我发现钱包不见了。
items.py: wǒ fā xiàn qián bāo bú jiàn le
items.en: I found that my wallet was missing.
items.why: Noticing something that is already the case is 发现. 发明 is making something new.

items.q: 这是一本___中国节日的书。
items.zh: 这是一本关于中国节日的书。
items.py: zhè shì yì běn guān yú zhōng guó jié rì de shū
items.en: This is a book about Chinese festivals.
items.why: A topic before 的 + noun is introduced by 关于. 对于 means 'towards, as for'.

items.q: ___我来说，汉字比语法难。
items.zh: 对于我来说，汉字比语法难。
items.py: duì yú wǒ lái shuō hàn zì bǐ yǔ fǎ nán
items.en: For me, characters are harder than grammar.
items.why: 'As for me' is 对于…来说. 关于 only names a topic and does not pair with 来说.

items.q: 我每天去学校都___一家邮局。
items.zh: 我每天去学校都经过一家邮局。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān qù xué xiào dōu jīng guò yì jiā yóu jú
items.en: Every day on my way to school I pass a post office.
items.why: Going past a place on the way is 经过. 通过 means by means of or passing a test.

items.q: 他没有___这次汉语考试，还要再考一次。
items.zh: 他没有通过这次汉语考试，还要再考一次。
items.py: tā méi yǒu tōng guò zhè cì hàn yǔ kǎo shì hái yào zài kǎo yí cì
items.en: He didn't pass this Chinese exam and has to take it again.
items.why: Passing a test is 通过. 经过 means going past a place or going through a process.

items.q: ___看电视，我们可以了解到很多中国的文化。
items.zh: 通过看电视，我们可以了解到很多中国的文化。
items.py: tōng guò kàn diàn shì wǒ men kě yǐ liǎo jiě dào hěn duō zhōng guó de wén huà
items.en: By watching TV we can learn a lot about Chinese culture.
items.why: 'By means of watching TV' is 通过. 经过 is for going past a place or through a process.

items.q: 这台机器是小王的爸爸自己___的，商店里买不到。
items.zh: 这台机器是小王的爸爸自己发明的，商店里买不到。
items.py: zhè tái jī qì shì xiǎo wáng de bà ba zì jǐ fā míng de shāng diàn lǐ mǎi bu dào
items.en: This machine was invented by Xiao Wang's father himself; you can't buy it in the shops.
items.why: Creating something new is 发明. 发现 means finding what already exists.

items.s: 关于我来说，运动很重要。
items.s_py: guān yú wǒ lái shuō yùn dòng hěn zhòng yào
items.zh: 对于我来说，运动很重要。
items.py: duì yú wǒ lái shuō yùn dòng hěn zhòng yào
items.en: For me, exercise is very important.
items.why: 'As for me' is 对于…来说. 关于 only introduces a topic.

items.s: 这是一部关于春节的电影。
items.s_py: zhè shì yí bù guān yú chūn jié de diàn yǐng
items.zh: 这是一部关于春节的电影。
items.py: zhè shì yí bù guān yú chūn jié de diàn yǐng
items.en: This is a film about the Spring Festival.
items.why: 关于 + topic + 的 + noun is the standard way to say 'about'.

items.s: 我每天上班都通过那家银行。
items.s_py: wǒ měi tiān shàng bān dōu tōng guò nà jiā yín háng
items.zh: 我每天上班都经过那家银行。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān shàng bān dōu jīng guò nà jiā yín háng
items.en: I pass that bank every day on my way to work.
items.why: Going past a building is 经过. 通过 means by means of or passing a test.

items.q: 三年___，这里还是一家小面馆，现在已经是大饭店了。
items.zh: 三年以前，这里还是一家小面馆，现在已经是大饭店了。
items.py: sān nián yǐ qián zhè lǐ hái shi yì jiā xiǎo miàn guǎn xiàn zài yǐ jīng shì dà fàn diàn le
items.en: Three years ago this was still a small noodle shop; now it is a big restaurant.
items.why: A length of time plus 以前 means 'ago'. 的时候 cannot follow a span like 三年.

items.q: 吃完饭___，我想去散步。
items.zh: 吃完饭以后，我想去散步。
items.py: chī wán fàn yǐ hòu wǒ xiǎng qù sàn bù
items.en: After eating I want to go for a walk.
items.why: 吃完饭 is a clause, and 'after a clause' is 以后. 后来 never follows a clause.

items.s: 关于我来说，这个办公室太小了。
items.s_py: guān yú wǒ lái shuō zhè ge bàn gōng shì tài xiǎo le
items.zh: 对于我来说，这个办公室太小了。
items.py: duì yú wǒ lái shuō zhè ge bàn gōng shì tài xiǎo le
items.en: For me, this office is too small.
items.why: 'As far as I'm concerned' is 对于…来说. 关于 only introduces a topic and never goes with 来说.

items.s: 我小的以前，住在爷爷家。
items.s_py: wǒ xiǎo de yǐ qián zhù zài yé ye jiā
items.zh: 我小的时候，住在爷爷家。
items.py: wǒ xiǎo de shí hou zhù zài yé ye jiā
items.en: When I was little I lived at grandpa's house.
items.why: 'When I was little' is 我小的时候. 以前 means 'before' and cannot replace 的时候.

items.s: 明年我搬到新家，后来我要买一张大桌子。
items.s_py: míng nián wǒ bān dào xīn jiā hòu lái wǒ yào mǎi yì zhāng dà zhuō zi
items.zh: 明年我搬到新家，然后我要买一张大桌子。
items.py: míng nián wǒ bān dào xīn jiā rán hòu wǒ yào mǎi yì zhāng dà zhuō zi
items.en: Next year I'll move into a new home, and then I'll buy a big table.
items.why: 后来 only tells a past story. The next step in a future plan is 然后.

items.q: 下班___，我们一起去吃饭吧。
items.zh: 下班以后，我们一起去吃饭吧。
items.py: xià bān yǐ hòu wǒ men yì qǐ qù chī fàn ba
items.en: Let's go and eat together after work.
items.why: 'After a clause' is clause + 以后. 后来 and 然后 never attach to the end of a clause like 下班.

items.s: 这个房子很合适我们一家人住。
items.s_py: zhè ge fáng zi hěn hé shì wǒ men yì jiā rén zhù
items.zh: 这个房子很适合我们一家人住。
items.py: zhè ge fáng zi hěn shì hé wǒ men yì jiā rén zhù
items.en: This house is just right for our family to live in.
items.why: 合适 is an adjective and cannot take an object. With 我们一家人 following, we need the verb 适合.

items.s: 我做饭的时，常常听音乐。
items.s_py: wǒ zuò fàn de shí cháng cháng tīng yīn yuè
items.zh: 我做饭的时候，常常听音乐。
items.py: wǒ zuò fàn de shí hou cháng cháng tīng yīn yuè
items.en: I often listen to music while I cook.
items.why: 'When' is 的时候 (or 时 without 的). The half form 的时 does not exist.

items.q: 你___明天几点开会吗？
items.zh: 你知道明天几点开会吗？
items.py: nǐ zhī dào míng tiān jǐ diǎn kāi huì ma
items.en: Do you know what time the meeting is tomorrow?
items.why: 知道 takes a fact or a question clause such as a time. 认识 is only for people, characters and roads.

items.q: 我先去银行取钱，___去超市买菜。
items.zh: 我先去银行取钱，然后去超市买菜。
items.py: wǒ xiān qù yín háng qǔ qián rán hòu qù chāo shì mǎi cài
items.en: I'll go to the bank to get some money first, and then go to the supermarket for food.
items.why: 先…然后 links two steps in a plan. 后来 is only for past stories, and 以后 does not link the next step after 先; it follows a clause or means 'in future'.

items.q: 小王在聚会上把我介绍给了新同事，现在我们___了。
items.zh: 小王在聚会上把我介绍给了新同事，现在我们认识了。
items.py: xiǎo wáng zài jù huì shàng bǎ wǒ jiè shào gěi le xīn tóng shì xiàn zài wǒ men rèn shi le
items.en: Xiao Wang introduced me to the new colleague at the party, so now we know each other.
items.why: After an introduction two people have met, which is 认识. 知道 would only mean knowing of someone, and 了解 means knowing in depth.

items.q: 他一个人在国外___了很多事，所以很成熟。
items.zh: 他一个人在国外经历了很多事，所以很成熟。
items.py: tā yí ge rén zài guó wài jīng lì le hěn duō shì suǒ yǐ hěn chéng shú
items.en: Living abroad on his own, he went through a lot, so he is very mature.
items.why: Here we need a verb 'go through', which is 经历. 经验 is only a noun and cannot take 了.

items.s: 老师讲得很懂，我们都听明白了。
items.s_py: lǎo shī jiǎng de hěn dǒng wǒ men dōu tīng míng bai le
items.zh: 老师讲得很清楚，我们都听明白了。
items.py: lǎo shī jiǎng de hěn qīng chu wǒ men dōu tīng míng bai le
items.en: The teacher explained it very clearly, and we all understood.
items.why: How well someone explains is 讲得很清楚. 懂 is what the listener does, so 讲得很懂 is wrong.

items.q: 我学会做饭___，常常给家人做菜。
items.zh: 我学会做饭以后，常常给家人做菜。
items.py: wǒ xué huì zuò fàn yǐ hòu cháng cháng gěi jiā rén zuò cài
items.en: After I learned to cook, I often made meals for my family.
items.why: 学会做饭 is a clause, and 'after a clause' is clause + 以后, past or future. 后来 stands alone at the start of a later part of a story and can never be attached to a clause.

items.q: 我们明天去___那家新的美术馆。
items.zh: 我们明天去参观那家新的美术馆。
items.py: wǒ men míng tiān qù cān guān nà jiā xīn de měi shù guǎn
items.en: We're going to visit that new art museum tomorrow.
items.why: 参观 is for a place you look round. 看望 is only for a person you go to see.

items.q: ___我每个星期都去游泳，对身体有好处。
items.zh: 以后我每个星期都去游泳，对身体有好处。
items.py: yǐ hòu wǒ měi ge xīng qī dōu qù yóu yǒng duì shēn tǐ yǒu hǎo chu
items.en: From now on I'll go swimming every week; it's good for my health.
items.why: A resolution for the future starts with 以后 ('from now on'). 后来 only looks back, and 然后 needs a step before it.

items.q: 吃了药以后，我___头还是很疼。
items.zh: 吃了药以后，我觉得头还是很疼。
items.py: chī le yào yǐ hòu wǒ jué de tóu hái shi hěn téng
items.en: Even after taking the medicine, my head still really hurts.
items.why: Feeling pain is a body sensation, so 觉得. 认为 is a formal judgement and never used for body feelings.

items.s: 他上个星期感冒了，这个星期再感冒了。
items.s_py: tā shàng ge xīng qī gǎn mào le zhè ge xīng qī zài gǎn mào le
items.zh: 他上个星期感冒了，这个星期又感冒了。
items.py: tā shàng ge xīng qī gǎn mào le zhè ge xīng qī yòu gǎn mào le
items.en: He caught a cold last week, and this week he has a cold again.
